HPX_PRINTERS_DETAILS.py.summary: HPXPrinterDetails is an Android Smart Flow page class for HP printer details screen automation. This class provides automation for a wide range of printer-related UI elements and actions, including navigation, verification, and interaction with tiles and buttons. Key features include swipe-and-find patterns for scrollable elements, consistent timeout and error handling parameters, text extraction for product information, fallback gesture clicks, conditional interactions for optional UI elements, and navigation flows for printer information, reports, and various printer functions. The class inherits from SmartFlow, leveraging common mobile automation capabilities.
